acceptance_criteria: Use Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct as the base and train an isolated LoRA adapter on separate synthetic data.
Keep all four eval-fixtures-v7 cases and their source files out of training.
Run matched base-versus-adapter evaluations and report quality, hallucinations, latency, token counts, errors, and exact model/runtime identities.
Do not modify production provider, config, routing, or model profile; do not merge, publish, or promote the adapter.
Do not train while another owner has an active GPU reservation or foreground use.
Treat the four-case, one-project result as a pilot signal, not production qualification.
task_preprocessing_card_pilot.blocker: The latest Hub readiness check reports qwen2.5-coder:7b active. GPU reservation is free, but the loaded foreground model remains in use; do not compete with it.
task_preprocessing_card_pilot.description: Build a synthetic training set separate from the held-out benchmark, download the authorized base model, prepare an isolated PEFT/LoRA environment, train one experimental adapter when GPU use is safe, and compare base versus adapter without production routing changes.
task_preprocessing_card_pilot.next_action: Wait until qwen2.5-coder:7b is no longer active, then train the isolated LoRA adapter and run paired evaluation.
